answer: Because the timing is logged against the cedar challenge, the oasis audit can replay the thread history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 267 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1817 identities would post 516 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
